GROSS_INCOME_WITHIN_LIMIT: Your income is within the limit for this program.
GROSS_INCOME_OVER_LIMIT: Your income looks higher than the limit for this program.
NET_INCOME_WITHIN_LIMIT: Your income after deductions is within the limit.
NET_INCOME_OVER_LIMIT: Your income after deductions looks higher than the limit.
ASSETS_WITHIN_LIMIT: Your savings are within the limit.
ASSETS_OVER_LIMIT: Your savings look higher than the limit.
INCOME_WITHIN_MARGIN: Your income is close to the limit, so it's worth applying to be sure.
CATEGORICALLY_ELIGIBLE_VIA_RECEIPT: Because you already get cash assistance, you likely qualify automatically.
ADJUNCTIVELY_ELIGIBLE_VIA_RECEIPT: Because you already get another benefit, you likely meet the income rule.
SNAP_ABAWD_TIME_LIMIT_MAY_APPLY: A work rule with a time limit may apply. It does not stop you from applying.
VEHICLE_ASSET_MAY_APPLY: The value of a vehicle may count toward the limit. A caseworker will check this.
SNAP_ESTIMATED_BENEFIT: We estimated your monthly benefit. The real amount is set when you apply.
SNAP_MINIMUM_BENEFIT_APPLIED: Small households get at least the minimum benefit.
MEDICAID_CHILD_WITHIN_LIMIT: This child's household income is within the limit for kids.
MEDICAID_ADULT_WITHIN_LIMIT: This adult's income is within the limit.
MEDICAID_PREGNANT_WITHIN_LIMIT: Income is within the limit for pregnancy coverage.
MEDICAID_NONMAGI_PATHWAY_POSSIBLE: There may be another way to qualify (for older adults or people with disabilities). A navigator can help.
MEDICAID_HOUSEHOLD_ASSUMPTION: We made an assumption about who is in the household. Answers may change the result.
WIC_CATEGORY_MATCHED: Someone in your household fits a WIC group (pregnant, recently gave birth, breastfeeding, or a child under 5).
WIC_NO_CATEGORY: No one in your household fits a WIC group right now.
WIC_RISK_ASSESSED_AT_CLINIC: A WIC clinic will check nutrition needs to finish deciding.
TANF_NO_DEPENDENT_CHILD: This program is for households with a child. No child is listed in your household.
TANF_PREGNANCY_MAY_QUALIFY: Some states cover a pregnant person before the baby is born. It's worth asking.
AGE_NEAR_CATEGORY_BOUNDARY: An age you entered is close to a cutoff for this program. An exact birth date would make this result more sure.
STATUS_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW: Immigration status can be complex. A navigator can help, and it does not stop you from applying.
STATUS_NOT_A_DISQUALIFIER: Immigration status alone does not disqualify you.
RESULT_LIMITED_BY_MISSING_INCOME_ATTRIBU: Telling us who earns each income would make this result more exact.
MISSING_REQUIRED_INPUT: We need a little more information to be sure.
DATA_MAY_BE_OUT_OF_DATE: These figures may be out of date. Please double-check with the agency.
PROGRAM_NOT_YET_SUPPORTED: We don't have the rules for this program in your state yet.
